description: Trace military-authorized patient transfers without endangering hospital staff.
offerText: Trace military-authorized patient transfers without endangering hospital staff.

stages.description: Compare Milena’s mother’s journal with hospital transfer dates.
Ask Nadia about the military authorization code on the transfer forms.
Choose whether to keep copies, expose the transfers, or hand the papers to Pavel.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Trace military-authorized patient transfers without endangering hospital staff.
implementationNotes: Create patient transfer form as quest evidence; keep original journal item unchanged.
Choice expose: Milena publicly challenges officials; after one day she is detained/transferred, leaving an optional rescue hook.
Choice hand over: Nadia retains job, records confiscated, Milena distrusts player.
Choice copy: maintain quiet investigation, no immediate disappearance.
